hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Gas anchor
function: The downhole separator below the pump intake: fluid enters an outer mud anchor, gas breaks out upward, and liquid is drawn through a dip tube into the pump.

tabs.overview: Natural or poor-boy designs; sized so the downward liquid velocity is below the bubble rise velocity.
tabs.evidence: Gas separator types per PetroWiki sucker-rod lift (S39).
